# CANDIDATE: VWAP_DEVIATION_MEAN_REVERSION_WITH_RSI

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large VWAP deviations coupled with extreme RSI indicate exhaustion and a high‑probability snap‑back to VWAP. This edge exists because extreme deviations often reflect overreaction, and RSI>70/<30 confirms overbought/oversold conditions, increasing the likelihood of mean reversion.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If price moves >1.0×ATR(14) above VWAP and RSI(14)>70, enter short at the bar’s close; if price moves >1.0×ATR below VWAP and RSI<30, enter long at the close. Exit: Stop at the VWAP level (chart‑stop); target at 0.5×ATR beyond entry in the opposite direction or exit half‑position when price re‑crosses VWAP. Regime filter: VIX >18 and time 10:30‑15:30 ET to avoid opening‑gap noise.
